tips.text: Buy extra relics for Hydroid Prime Systems; it is the Rare part in every one of them.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Run Radiant radshare so the Rare-part relics get refined to Radiant together.
Refine only the Rare-part relics to Radiant; leave the Chassis relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
